summary: Build supplier data, contract, and decarbonisation skills with practical Scope 3 emissions procurement training. Enquire about delivery options.
lede: Scope 3 emissions operationalisation connects value-chain emissions data with procurement and supplier decisions. Designed for intermediate procurement, supply chain, finance and sustainability practitioners, this training covers screening material sources, calculating and quality-scoring supplier data, and selecting engagement and low-carbon sourcing actions. Learners also practise drafting contract measures and building reporting controls and roadmaps to track progress.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who connect supplier decisions, emissions evidence, commercial risk, and ESG reporting. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with procurement, supply chain, finance, sustainability, or value-chain projects and need a practical Scope 3 operating model.
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to procurement, supplier management, supply chain operations, corporate finance, sustainability, ESG reporting, or value-chain projects. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with organisational emissions, purchase-spend data, supplier records, or basic spreadsheet analysis will help you complete the exercises efficiently. Advanced topics such as SBTi target-setting, IFRS S2, and AI-assisted data review are taught at conceptual and operational application level, not technical engineering level.
